name: Drowned Domain
description: Pull a nearby hostile mob into a separate island dimension for 40 seconds. The expanded island has a larger two-block-deep water side and four massive pirate ships. After five seconds, fast cannonballs fire inward from the walls every half-second. Their damage is 30% of your attack damage plus 1.5 per completed 10% Blood charge. You gain 50% movement speed, powerful swimming, Regeneration II and 50% lifesteal while inside.
